channel.title: Writing on AI Products, Data and PropTech | Ahmadreza Samadi
channel.description: Articles and explainers by Ahmadreza Samadi on building AI products, AI costs and decision models, connected apps, and real estate technology.

item.title: How many coffees must a cafe sell before it makes any profit?
item.description: A fictional cafe sells 100 coffees for $500 and makes $0 operating profit. Follow its costs to understand contribution and break-even.

item.title: Why can AI lose track of something you already said?
item.description: Chat history, working context, summaries, saved memory and training are different things. Understand why a chatbot can miss an earlier detail and how to help.

item.title: Why is Wi-Fi slow even with full bars?
item.description: Full Wi-Fi bars describe your signal to the router, not the speed of the whole internet route. Learn what else can slow it down and how to compare.
item.dc:creator: Ahmadreza Samadi

item.title: How does a contactless card work without a battery?
item.description: A payment terminal briefly powers the chip in a passive contactless card. Follow the energy and the payment data through a tap.

item.title: How do headphones cancel noise by making more sound?

item.title: How does your phone turn text in a photo into copyable words?
item.description: OCR finds text regions and recognises visual patterns as letters and words. The AI feature can save typing, but copied text still needs checking.

item.title: Why do identical-looking USB-C cables behave differently?
item.description: USB-C describes the connector. Power, file-transfer speed and video support are separate capabilities to check in the whole connection.

item.title: iPhone Duo: what does the extra $800 cost per day?

item.title: AI says 8% rental yield. Why is the owner still paying?

item.title: Why does your computer slow down when storage is almost full?

item.title: Does Incognito actually make you invisible?

item.title: Why does AI sound so confident when it is wrong?

item.title: How satellite messaging works without cell towers

item.title: Humanoid robots at home: demos, shipments and autonomy
